defs.def: the right to do or say what you want without anyone stopping you （指权利）自由

ex.s: But such commitment can also weaken a sense of freedom.
ex.t: 但这种投入也会削弱自由感。

ex.s: That freedom to choose is one reason more people like to eat alone.
ex.t: 选择自由是越来越多的人喜欢独自就餐的一个原因。

ex.s: loss of freedom stimulates one's creativity
ex.t: A．失去自由会激发人的创造力

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: What new responsibilities will this freedom bring?
ex.t: 这种自由会带来什么新的责任？

ex.s: Of course, I would like to have more freedom with money and no doubt I will be getting a credit card at some point, but I currently don’t have a steady income, so getting a credit card might tempt me to spend more money than I have!
ex.t: 当然，我希望在花钱方面有更多的自由，毫无疑问，我会在某个时候拿到一张信用卡，但我目前没有稳定的收入，所以拿到信用卡可能会诱惑我花比拥有更多的钱！

ex.s: I enjoy the freedom and the sense of independence.
ex.t: 我享受这份自由和独立的感觉。

ex.s: It also earned Carson a posthumous Presidential Medal of Freedom and put her face on the 17-cent US stamp.
ex.t: 这也为卡森赢得了后继的总统自由勋章，并将她的脸贴在美国17美分邮票上。

ex.s: Phil Blythe explains: “For many older people, particularly those living alone or in the country, driving is important for preserving their independence, giving them the freedom to get out and about without having to rely on others.”
ex.t: 菲尔·布莱斯解释道：“对许多老年人来说，特别是那些独居或在乡村生活的人来说，驾驶对于保持独立性非常重要，让他们能够自由出行而不必依赖他人。”

defs.def: the state of being able to do what you want, without anything stopping you （指状态）自由
the state of not being a prisoner or slave 自由民地位（不是囚犯或奴隶）
the state of not being affected by the thing mentioned 没有 … 的情况；不受 … 影响的状态

ex.s: Indeed, the researchers found that face-to-face interactions and conversations affect the creative process, and yet a coworking space or a coffee shop provides a certain level of noise while also providing freedom from interruptions.
ex.t: 的确，研究人员发现面对面互动和对话会影响创造过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡店提供一定程度的噪音，同时也提供不受打扰的自由。

defs.def: permission to use sth without restriction 自由使用权

chunks.cn: 极贵重的物品指权利）自由
